manage.title: Manage SCIM connections
manage.description: Add, change and remove the identity providers that create and update Termix accounts.

connections.deleteConfirm: Delete this connection? The identity provider can no longer change accounts. The accounts it made stay in Termix.
connections.dialogDesc: Let an identity provider like Entra ID or Okta create, update and remove Termix accounts.
connections.name: Name
connections.enabledDesc: Accept requests from this identity provider.
connections.onDeleteDesc: What happens to the Termix account when the identity provider deletes the user.
connections.adoptExistingDesc: Link a pushed user to a Termix account with the same username or email instead of refusing it. Admin accounts are never taken over.
connections.defaultRolesDesc: Roles every user from this connection gets. Separate them with commas.
connections.allowAdminDesc: Allow a group to be mapped to the admin role. Members become Termix admins and lose it when they leave.
connections.unsupported: This Termix version cannot manage accounts from plugins yet. Update Termix to use SCIM.

setup.title: Identity provider setup
setup.baseUrlHint: Paste this as the SCIM base URL or tenant URL in your identity provider.
setup.tokenOnce: Copy the token now and paste it into your identity provider. It is not shown again.
setup.newTokenConfirm: Make a new token? The old one stops working right away.
setup.newTokenFailed: Could not make a new token

groups.title: Group roles
groups.hint: Groups your identity provider pushed. Members get the role you pick and lose it when they leave the group.
groups.saveFailed: Could not save the group role
